description: A `<var server>` in a non-entry `<page>` file that supplies its own server context via a `<db src=>` state block does NOT fire E-AUTH-005. The file carries no `<program>` at all — §40.8 forbids one in a non-entry file — so the pre-existing `<program db=>`-only predicate refused this shape, which is the canonical multi-file page form (§52.11 / §40.8 / §58.8).
